title: The Ghost Invoice
description: An advanced Academy file where chronology, unavailable evidence and uncertainty matter more than a loud accusation.
objectives: Inspect the published evidence and its provenance.
Compare competing explanations without treating similarity as guilt.
Submit a reproducible conclusion that leaves legitimate comparators visible.

narrative.fictionalization_statement: All people, organisations, accounts and events in this playable package are synthetic; real mechanisms are discussed separately from gameplay.
